from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        # Topic: Beyond the Infinite: Convergence and the 2-adic Metric
        # Section: The Paradox of the Growing Sum

            "Consider the series 1 plus 2 plus 4.",
            "Every step doubles the distance from zero.",
            "Digit the Rabbit jumps further and further away.",
            "Can we redefine distance to make this converge?"
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Standard sums grow without bound.
        # Draw a standard number line (#FFFFFF) with labels 0, 1, 3, 7, 15.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        nline = NumberLine(

            include_numbers=True,
            numbers_to_include=[0, 1, 3, 7, 15],

        )
        # Visuals start at column 3 to maintain gap (B021)
        self.place_in_area(nline, "D3", "D6")

            nline.animate.scale(0.5).move_to(self.grid["D2"]),
            rabbit.animate.move_to(rabbit_target_pos),
            path_arc=-0.8,
            run_time=2
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section1Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup the visual and structural layout
        self.setup_layout(
            "Beyond the Infinite: Convergence and the 2-adic Metric",
            [
                "- Standard Metric: 1, 2, 4, 8, ... diverges",
                "- 2-adic Metric: d(x,y) = |x-y|_2",
                "- Norm Definition: |2^k|_2 = 2^-k",
                "- Insight: High powers of 2 are 'small'",
                "- Result: 2^k converges to 0 in Q2"
            ]
        )
        
        # 2. Run the technical visualization
        self.animate_p_adic_convergence()

    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        """Initializes the background, title, lecture bullets, and the 6x6 animation grid."""
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        
        # Title placement (Top edge)
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.4)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Lecture bullet points (Left side)
        lecture_vgroup = VGroup(*[
            Text(line, font_size=20, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines
        ]).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
        
        self.lecture = lecture_vgroup.scale(0.85).to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(UP * 0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # 6x6 Animation Grid (Right side logic)
        # Using specific anchor points for mobjects to avoid overlap
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]

        for i, row_label in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col_label in enumerate(cols):
                # Coordinates shifted to the right side of the screen
                x_val = 1.4 + (j * 0.9)
                y_val = 2.0 - (i * 1.0)
                self.grid[row_label + col_label] = np.array([x_val, y_val, 0])

    def animate_p_adic_convergence(self):
        """Visualizes how the powers of 2 shrink under the 2-adic metric."""
        
        # Row C: The Sequence elements (2^n)
        powers = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        sequence_mobs = VGroup(*[
            MathTex(f"2^{{{p}}}") for p in powers
        ])
        
        for i, mob in enumerate(sequence_mobs):
            # Place in Row C across columns 1-6
            mob.move_to(self.grid[f"C{i+1}"]).scale(0.7)
            
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(m, shift=UP) for m in sequence_mobs], lag_ratio=0.15),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        # Row D: The 2-adic Norms (|2^n|_2)
        # Higher power = Smaller distance to zero
        norm_labels = VGroup(*[
            MathTex(rf"\left| 2^{{{p}}} \right|_2 = \frac{{1}}{{{2**p}}}") 
            for p in powers
        ])
        
        for i, n_mob in enumerate(norm_labels):
            n_mob.move_to(self.grid[f"D{i+1}"]).scale(0.55).set_color(YELLOW)

        self.play(Write(norm_labels), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # Row E: Visual Representation (Circles shrinking)
        # Size represents the 'magnitude' in the 2-adic sense
        circles = VGroup(*[
            Circle(
                radius=(0.5 / (1.5**p)), 
                color=BLUE, 
                fill_opacity=0.4, 
                stroke_width=2
            ) for p in powers
        ])
        
        for i, circ in enumerate(circles):
            circ.move_to(self.grid[f"E{i+1}"])

        self.play(
            Create(circles),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # Conclusion: Convergence indicator
        # Arrow from large numbers (visually) to the small limit
        conv_arrow = Arrow(
            start=self.grid["F1"], 
            end=self.grid["F5"] + RIGHT * 0.5, 
            color=GRAY_A, 
            buff=0.1
        )
        limit_tex = MathTex(
            r"\lim_{n \to \infty} 2^n = 0 \text{ in } \mathbb{Q}_2", 
            font_size=26, 
            color=BLUE_B
        ).next_to(conv_arrow, DOWN, buff=0.2)

        self.play(Create(conv_arrow))
        self.play(Write(limit_tex))
        
        # Final emphasis on the counter-intuitive nature of 2-adic convergence
        self.play(Indicate(limit_tex, color=YELLOW, scale_factor=1.2))
        self.wait(2)
